history.p: This overture is the only one of Gade's without a programmatic title. In his personal copy of the arrangement for piano four hands, however, somebody has added "Achilles-Ouverture", which corresponds with the description in an anonymous review in Allgemeine musikalische Zeitung, apart from the fact that the author thinks the music depicts a Nordic warrior.
